sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a traditional tag game that builds teamwork and agility on a rectangular court?
What is the main physical benefit of practicing Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation) daily?
options: A) It makes you jump higher
B) It improves overall flexibility and core strength
C) It helps you throw a ball faster
questions.answer: B) It improves overall flexibility and core strength

questions.question_text: In Kabaddi, what is the specific term used for the player who enters the opponent's half to tag them?
Which Yoga posture helps improve digestion and is one of the few poses that can be done immediately after eating?
How many players from a single team sit on the central line at the start of a Kho-Kho chase?
Which breathing technique in Yoga involves forceful exhalation to clear the respiratory system?
What is the primary purpose of performing 'Shavasana' (Corpse Pose) at the end of a Yoga session?
options: C) To achieve complete body and mind relaxation
D) To practice holding your breath
questions.answer: C) To achieve complete body and mind relaxation

questions.question_text: Which traditional Indian game involves striking a small, tapered wooden peg with a larger wooden stick?
Which Yoga pose mimics the shape of a snake raising its hood and effectively strengthens the lower back?
In the traditional game of Langdi, how must the active 'chaser' move across the field?
options: A) By sprinting as fast as possible
B) By crawling on hands and knees
C) By jumping with both feet together
D) By hopping continuously on one foot
questions.answer: D) By hopping continuously on one foot

questions.question_text: How does playing traditional community games like Kho-Kho benefit your physical stamina? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Playing Kho-Kho involves continuous running, rapid dodging, and quick direction changes. This constant high-energy movement significantly builds cardiovascular endurance and improves your overall leg stamina.

questions.question_text: Describe the correct breathing pattern when performing back-bending poses in Yoga. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: You should always inhale deeply while bending backward to expand your chest fully. Exhale slowly only when returning to the original straight starting position.

questions.question_text: Name two core muscles that are strengthened during the regular practice of Yoga Sadhana. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Practicing Yoga Sadhana primarily strengthens the abdominal muscles in your stomach area and the erector spinae muscles along your lower back, greatly improving core stability.

questions.question_text: What is the proper way to sit in Vajrasana (Diamond Pose)? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Kneel on the floor and gently sit back on your heels. Keep your back completely straight, rest your hands on your thighs, and look forward calmly.

questions.question_text: State the main role of a defender in a team game of Kabaddi. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A defender must work closely with their teammates in a defensive chain to block, trap, and firmly tackle the raider before they reach the midline.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are demonstrating Surya Namaskar to your classmates. Describe how breath synchronization flows with the first three movements. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Stand straight and exhale while bringing your palms together at your chest. Inhale deeply as you raise your arms and bend backward to stretch. Finally, exhale completely as you bend forward to touch your toes, keeping your legs completely straight throughout the movement.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are the captain of a Kho-Kho team. Describe the defensive strategy your players should use to avoid getting tagged by the chaser. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would instruct my defenders to stay extremely alert, maintain a low center of gravity, and always run in zigzag patterns. They must keep watching the active chaser closely and quickly change direction near the central pole to confuse and exhaust the opponent.

questions.question_text: Explain how daily practice of balancing Yoga poses, such as Garudasana (Eagle Pose), enhances both physical stability and mental focus for a student. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Practicing balancing poses forces the body to engage its core muscles constantly and adjust its weight, building excellent physical stability in the legs and ankles. Mentally, maintaining this tricky balance requires intense concentration, steady breathing, and complete calmness, which directly helps students improve their focus and attention span during their daily classroom studies.

questions.question_text: Describe how the traditional game of Kabaddi teaches important life skills like teamwork, quick decision-making, and physical resilience. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Kabaddi requires defenders to hold hands and move as one unit, teaching unbreakable teamwork. Raiders must decide instantly when to attack or retreat, sharpening quick decision-making under pressure. Constant tackling, escaping, and strict breath control build immense physical resilience, teaching players to stay tough and keep fighting until the whistle blows.
